items.name: theme
items.title: Sentinel theme
items.description: Sentinel design tokens (light + dark) and the Tailwind v4 @theme mapping. Install once before any component.
items.docs: Add `@import "../styles/sentinel-theme.css";` (path relative to your global CSS) right after `@import "tailwindcss";`. Dark mode: add `.dark` or `[data-snt-theme="dark"]` to an ancestor.

items.name: utils
items.title: Sentinel utils
items.description: cn() — merges Tailwind class names (clsx + tailwind-merge). Required by every Sentinel component.

items.name: activity-timeline
items.title: Activity Timeline
items.description: A time-ordered list of events: an attack timeline, an audit log, or the history of a finding.
items.docs: Activity Timeline (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/activity-timeline.md

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: An inline message tied to a page or section. It communicates a status that persists until the condition changes or the user dismisses it.
items.docs: Alert (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/alert.md

items.name: badge-tag
items.title: Badge · Tag
items.description: A small pill that labels an object with a status (**Badge**) or a category (**Tag**). It's the same primitive; Badge shows a status dot by default.
items.docs: Badge · Tag (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/badge-tag.md

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: A full-width strip at the top of the app for product-wide announcements, promotions or warnings.
items.docs: Banner (deprecated). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/banner.md

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Shows where the current page sits in the hierarchy and lets users jump back up.
items.docs: Breadcrumb (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/breadcrumb.md

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: Buttons trigger an action on the current page: submitting a form, opening a modal, starting a scan.
items.docs: Button (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/button.md

items.name: cards
items.title: Cards
items.description: Dashboard cards that summarise a topic and lead to a next step. There are two presets: **InsightCard** (a key/value list) and **AlertCard** (an active-issue callout).
items.docs: Cards (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/cards.md

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: A dependency-free set of SVG chart primitives in a shared card shell: donut, bar, line and treemap, plus stat blocks.
items.docs: Chart (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/chart.md

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: Lets the user turn an independent option on or off, or pick several items from a list.
items.docs: Checkbox (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/checkbox.md

items.name: cve-tag
items.title: CVE Tag
items.description: A CVE identifier that links to its advisory, with optional exploit signals: KEV (in CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog) and EPSS (probability of exploitation in the next 30 days).
items.docs: CVE Tag (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/cve-tag.md

items.name: cvss-score
items.title: CVSS Score
items.description: A CVSS base score with its qualitative rating and, when given the vector string, each metric in plain words.
items.docs: CVSS Score (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/cvss-score.md

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: A composable card that lists findings (threat, asset, date, severity) with a header, column headers, rows and a pagination footer.
items.docs: Data Table (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/data-table.md

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty State
items.description: Fills a region that has no content yet. It explains why it's empty and what to do next.
items.docs: Empty State (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/empty-state.md

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: A horizontal toolbar that combines search, filter pills and view actions above a table or list.
items.docs: Filter Bar (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/filter-bar.md

items.name: finding-status
items.title: Finding Status
items.description: Shows where a finding is in its lifecycle, from Open to Resolved, with an icon and a label for each status.
items.docs: Finding Status (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/finding-status.md

items.name: gauge
items.title: Gauge
items.description: A semicircular meter that shows a single value against a known maximum, such as a security score.
items.docs: Gauge (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/gauge.md

items.name: indicator
items.title: Indicator
items.description: An indicator of compromise (IP, domain, URL, hash, email) with type, reputation verdict and copy. Optional defanging (example[.]com).
items.docs: Indicator (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/indicator.md

items.name: masked-value
items.title: Masked Value
items.description: A secret — API key, token, password — shown masked, with reveal and copy.
items.docs: Masked Value (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/masked-value.md

items.name: modal
items.title: Modal
items.description: A dialog that interrupts the current task to request a decision or focused input. It traps focus and blocks interaction with the rest of the page until it closes.
items.docs: Modal (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/modal.md

items.name: scan-progress
items.title: Scan Progress
items.description: The stages of a scan or long job and where it is now: done, running, failed or pending.
items.docs: Scan Progress (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/scan-progress.md

items.name: search-bar
items.title: Search Bar
items.description: A text input dedicated to searching or filtering content, with a search icon and a clear button.
items.docs: Search Bar (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/search-bar.md

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: A single-choice dropdown that picks one value from a list of options.
items.docs: Select (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/select.md

items.name: severity-badge
items.title: Severity Badge
items.description: The canonical way to show a finding's severity (Critical → Info), optionally with its numeric score (e.g. CVSS).
items.docs: Severity Badge (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/severity-badge.md

items.name: severity-bar
items.title: Severity Bar
items.description: One horizontal bar that splits a set of findings by severity, with an optional legend of counts.
items.docs: Severity Bar (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/severity-bar.md

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A pulsing placeholder that mirrors the shape of content while it loads.
items.docs: Skeleton (beta). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/skeleton.md

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An indeterminate loading indicator for short waits when the shape of the result is unknown.
items.docs: Spinner (alpha). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/spinner.md

items.name: switch-radio
items.title: Switch · Radio
items.description: **Switch** turns a single setting on or off, effective immediately. **Radio** picks exactly one option from a small, visible set.
items.docs: Switch · Radio (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/switch-radio.md

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Switches between related views of the same object without leaving the page.
items.docs: Tabs (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/tabs.md

items.name: text-field
items.title: Text Field
items.description: A single-line input for short free text: names, domains, IPs, emails.
items.docs: Text Field (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/text-field.md

items.name: text-space
items.title: Text Space
items.description: A rich-text composer (toolbar + writing area) for formatted notes, reports and comments.
items.docs: Text Space (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/text-space.md

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line plain-text input for notes, descriptions and justifications.
items.docs: Textarea (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/textarea.md

items.name: toast-tooltip
items.title: Toast · Tooltip
items.description: **Toast** is a brief, non-blocking confirmation of something that just happened. **Tooltip** is a short label or hint that appears on hover or focus of a control.
items.docs: Toast · Tooltip (stable). Usage, accessibility and known gaps: http://localhost:3000/docs/components/toast-tooltip.md
